added_claim_errors: Cites 《浙江省企业工资支付管理办法》第19条 for the 5-day wage settlement. The content matches the key, but the article number and the gov.cn link (content_5719128) can't be checked against the key and look doubtful for a provincial regulation.

Suggests mailing by EMS on 10月26日 as a way to make sure the notice arrives that day. A letter posted by EMS arrives a day or more later, so this advice is slightly inconsistent; A does note elsewhere that a later receipt moves the date to 11月26日.

The long overtime and Art. 38 forced-resignation section (with economic compensation of about 2 months) rests on a guess that the person worked unpaid overtime. The law it states is correct (150/200/300%, N=2), but the premise is unverified and it adds length.
Names "杭州市区劳动人事争议仲裁委员会" as the arbitration body. Arbitration is handled by the commission with jurisdiction over the employer's location or district, and this exact institution name is unverifiable.

Warns that the company might dismiss the worker for misconduct and so avoid paying the leave money. That is misleading: under 实施办法第十二条 unused-leave pay is still owed when the contract ends for any reason.
Says such clauses are "在仲裁和诉讼中基本都被认定无效". This is a generalization about case outcomes with no source given, though it is plausible.
Cites 实施办法第十八条 as the rule that the leave year is the calendar year. From my own knowledge this is likely correct, but I did not verify it against a source.

reasons: Both answers correct both false premises at the start: the 60-day notice period and the need for approval. Both give a letter written as a 解除劳动合同通知书 and get the same correct numbers: last day 11月25日 (Wednesday), 329/365×5 = 4.51 rounded down to 4 days, 12000/21.75 = 551.72, and 4,413.79 extra at 200% with the 300% total explained. A adds a hedged note on the confidentiality-role exception and the 20% wage-deduction rule. B cites 民法典第二百零一条 for the day count, says outright that the new job can start 11月26日, gives the one-year arbitration limit, and is noticeably shorter. A's long sections on overtime, Art. 38 and a cited source list make it longer than the key's 篇幅适中 standard, so B wins by a slight margin.
